correctness.rationale: The output has a constant value per cell, hence G(Px)=ab|mu_A(x)-mu_B(x)| exactly. Coarea/layer-cake reduces the induced seminorm of this constant-preserving linear map to indicators of nontrivial cuts. For coefficients +p_i in A and -q_j in B (sum zero), maximizing a signed cut of given cardinality means taking the k largest coefficients. A cut of size k<=a yields the top-k p partial sum; its complement gives the q family. This proves the exact sorted-partial-sum formula, attainment and complete polyhedral nonexpansivity criteria. The TV-distance sufficient radii follow from P_k^down<=k/a+d_TV(p,u_A), with smallest slack (a-1)/(ab); one-heavy-coordinate perturbations show each radius is sharp separately. Strict mass positivity makes the all-weights envelope ab/(n-1) unattained for a,b>=2. Independent rational enumeration of every cut for each a,b=1..5 and nonuniform increasing rational weights matched all 25 formulas. This is finite corroboration, not proof of all a,b.
